title: Marketing + campaigns: festivals restyle, campaign template picker, themed confirms
goal: Marketing pages are contract-clean and festival/campaign flows work end to end now that the backend tables and routes exist.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Verified: marketing/festivals uses saturated gradient banners, emoji and a gray-800 title on dark (1.26:1) (BUG-050 part); the festivals API now works (B02 migration 0035). campaigns/new/page.tsx:225 is a raw ID input (BUG-057 part) -> RelationCombobox (templates via GET /templates which now returns 200). campaigns/[id]/page.tsx:94,123,134 use window.confirm (BUG-045 part); recipients tab works after B12. marketing/page.tsx and festivals have nested scroll wrappers (BUG-048 part). 108 raw palette sites in marketing/. W6 RULES: you run in parallel with 11 other page batches in separate worktrees - touch ONLY your allowlist; never edit lint-baseline.json (the orchestrator ratchets it after merge); shared-file needs go to desktop/audit/fix/requests/<BATCH_ID>.md.
steps: Festivals: ds-token cards, readable titles in both themes, no emoji; list/create/edit through the API with RBAC errors handled.
campaigns/new: template field -> RelationCombobox over message templates (read-only use of src/lib/api/templates.ts); segment/contact pickers likewise.
campaigns/[id]: send/cancel/delete via useConfirm; recipients tab loads.
Flyers, segments, social, whatsapp, opted-out, branding pages swept.

CONTRACT SWEEP on every non-spec file in your allowlist (do this while fixing the bugs above, file by file): (a) `node scripts/lint-gate.mjs --zero <your allowlist globs>` must report 0 errors in your files: replace `any` with real types imported from desktop/src/lib/api/*, delete unused vars/imports, remove raw hex/rgb/px literals and raw Tailwind palette classes. Token map: gray/slate text -> text-ds-foreground / text-ds-foreground-muted / text-ds-foreground-subtle; gray backgrounds -> bg-ds-surface / bg-ds-surface-sunken / bg-ds-surface-raised; borders -> border-ds-border / border-ds-border-strong; green/emerald -> ds-success (+ -subtle bg, -on-subtle text); red/rose -> ds-danger; amber/yellow/orange -> ds-warning; blue/sky/cyan -> ds-info; indigo/violet/purple/orange-as-brand/primary-NNN -> ds-primary; chart colours -> ds-chart-1..6 or useThemeTokens(); arbitrary px (text-[13px], w-[240px], h-[600px]) -> Tailwind scale (text-sm, w-60) or ds spacing (p-ds-4, gap-ds-2).

LAYOUT: every page root uses an archetype (ListPage / EntityForm / DetailPage) or `<PageContainer>` from @/components/layout/page-container with a PageHeader (title + description + actions). Remove ad-hoc root padding (p-6, px-8, container mx-auto) and any page-level scroll wrapper (`h-full overflow-auto`, `flex-1 overflow-y-auto`) - <main> is the only page scroller; tables scroll inside DataTable's data-scroll-region (BUG-048 contribution).

FIELDS: native `<input type="date">` -> DatePicker (+ toLocalDateString / parseLocalDate from @/lib/dates); money `type="number"` inputs -> CurrencyInput; any id/relation text input -> RelationCombobox (with resolveSelected for edit forms); phone -> PhoneInput; `window.confirm` / bare `confirm(` -> `useConfirm()` from @/components/ui; `toLocaleDateString()` / `toLocaleString()` without a locale -> formatDisplayDate from @/lib/dates (en-IN); no mailto:/wa.me/tel: (SendMessageDialog). Icon-only buttons get an aria-label. Never two elements with the same id on one page.

PROBE: with your stack slot up, run `node scripts/layout-probe.mjs --routes /marketing,/marketing/festivals,/marketing/flyers,/marketing/flyers/templates,/marketing/segments,/marketing/social,/marketing/whatsapp,/marketing/opted-out,/marketing/branding,/marketing/campaigns,/campaigns,/campaigns/new,/campaigns/<campaignId> --viewports 1366x768,1920x1080 --themes light,dark --out audit/fix/probe/<BATCH_ID>` (replace <id> placeholders with real seeded ids from the API) and fix every failure (gutter, horizontal overflow, nested scroller, console/page error, blank top-bar title). Attach probe.json summary to your report.

SPECS: run the specs listed in gates.specs; fix app regressions. If a spec asserts behaviour this batch intentionally changed, update that spec (spec files in your allowlist only). Pre-existing failures that belong to another batch: list them in your report, do not chase them.

If you need a change in a shared file you may not touch (ui primitives, archetypes, client, globals, helpers), do NOT edit it: write the request to desktop/audit/fix/requests/<BATCH_ID>.md (file per batch, so parallel merges never conflict) and work around locally where possible. B30 consumes these requests.

From the B17 triage: marketing-social.spec.ts:301 (:333) - the festival card toggle locator (text=<festival> + ../../..) no longer contains the Activate/Deactivate button. Give the festival card a stable test id / accessible structure (role=article with aria-label, toggle button with accessible name) while restyling, and update the spec to use it. marketing-social.spec.ts must pass.
mustNotTouch: any file owned by another W6 batch (see FIX-PLAN.md section 6 ownership table)
acceptance: /marketing/festivals loads (no 500) and is readable in dark.
campaigns/new has no raw ID input.
